title: The Love of God
definition: The love of God is His perfect and eternal commitment to seek the good of His people and redeem sinners through Jesus Christ.
summary: God's love is holy, faithful, sacrificial, and steadfast. It is not sentimental weakness, but covenant mercy and saving grace toward undeserving sinners.
christFocus: God's love is displayed most clearly at the cross where Christ died for sinners.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's love is holy, faithful, sacrificial, and steadfast. It is not sentimental weakness, but covenant mercy and saving grace toward undeserving sinners.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
